source_constants.fit_policy: Mean baseline and additive median-residual correction fitted only on all43 Phase17 compounds, before external model outputs. No slope fitting or hyperparameter selection.

calibration_fit.method: Add median(observed-predicted) on calibration subset only

full_raw.interpretation: Descriptive paired scaffold resampling conditional on fitted offsets; excludes calibration fitting uncertainty and pretrained-data uncertainty.

heldout_assay_calibrated.interpretation: Descriptive paired scaffold resampling conditional on fitted offsets; excludes calibration fitting uncertainty and pretrained-data uncertainty.

analysis.warning: Calibration-set fit is not scored as evidence of generalization. No fitted scale/slope or best-offset selection. The diagnostic regression on test outputs is descriptive, not a deployable calibrator.

limits: Separate publication/assay and no exact/achiral structure overlap with Phase17, but pretrained-model training overlap is unknown.
Assay-condition and construct transfer, not matched laboratory simulation. No explicit ATP, GST, substrate or luciferase/HTRF modeling.
Calibration is a scalar correction of model output, not improved molecular physics; two seeds are not physical replicates.
Small scaffold-disjoint test subset yields limited precision. Eligibility and split chosen before external outputs; labels were accessible for audit, so not a blinded benchmark.
No novel candidates screened and no conclusion about cryoprotection, cell viability/function, toxicity or selectivity.
